Swarm is a decentralized peer-to-peer storage and communication platform. Swarm uses its native BZZ token to incentivize nodes that store and relay data. Swarm is designed to operate within the Ethereum ecosystem.

Storj is a decentralized cloud object storage network. Storj splits and encrypts stored data across many independent storage nodes. Storj uses the STORJ token for payments between data users and storage providers.

SAFE is a multi-signature smart contract wallet on Ethereum. SAFE requires a defined number of owner approvals before a transaction is executed. SAFE is formerly known as Gnosis Safe.

Arweave is a decentralized network for permanent data storage. Arweave charges a one-time upfront fee intended to fund long-term storage of data. Arweave uses the AR token as its native currency.

GMX is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange. GMX operates on the Arbitrum and Avalanche blockchains. GMX uses a shared liquidity pool, known as GLP, as the counterparty for traders.
